sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match of level, day, and recency claim.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Document is J.P. Morgan Rates Strategy speaking in first person; attribution and framing match.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: Trade level, entry, and stop match exactly, correctly attributed to JPMorgan.

sentences.span: Citi's rates desk, by contrast, sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold on a closing basis.
sentences.why: Attribution to Citi and the view stated match exactly.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener; a soft print would not by itself reverse it while the Fed stays on hold.
sentences.why: Preserves the asymmetric conditional exactly: hot print confirms, soft print does not by itself reverse, still contingent on the Fed staying on hold. 'our steepener' correctly rendered as 'the steepener' referring to JPM's trade in context.
